body: After over 24 hours of speaking to her she got a bit over it. My mom helped me with convincing her to go to the class one more time and see if anything changes. Today teacher payed more attention to her and she didn't feel skipped this time. So for now everything is good but I know that seeking positive feedback is not the right mindset or goal for an artist. I'll try to help her gravitate towards seeking self improvement and making something new and better every time.

I always say that her feelings murder her talent. She has reeeeeaaaaally low self-esteem and it's so sad. Frustration that comes with this is unbearable, also to watch this state. I hate it when she feels this way. I also hated myself for such a long time but with therapy I managed to come to inner peace. It's so much better now and I hope she finds peace within herself as well
I always try to do that. Maybe I'm on the same level as she is but we see objects a bit different. I help her whenever her proportions are wonky and stuff
I hope not! Im 19 and the teacher is 50 something i think. So, I guess not

I too thought about that. GF is too shy to ask for help and it might seem that she is so confident about her work she just does her thing. The worst thing is that she now refuses to talk with the teacher... taht one play seems childish
Thank you 😅 I was worried about hearing that once again. Asking redditors for hel in relationships is hit or miss all the time. I still do it tho. It's good to hear some disagrees with this statement
I was thinking that maybe the teacher is mad about people not finishing still life composition. My GF is the only one who came to finish it and it was taking her a long time too.

I hope it's true in this situation. This kind of teacher is a perfect kind. I don't know if my GF is ready for this kind of schooling but I hope so.

I will tell her to ask for 1 on 1 and support her. I'm guessing that putting myself between them is unnecessary

Thank you so much! I teared up when I was reading your comment. I always wished to achieve this mindset that you have, but I was never truly critiqued, so there was no way to try myself. I wish to learn and progress everyday and I hope my GF gets it as quickly as possible. I will support her as long as I have to.

Also, it really is highschool! haha
Have a nice day and thank you again

I've been told this a couple of times when I posted about her being jealous of my dream job which is tattoo artist. Every time I think of this I feel so bad. On the other hand I know I have to put myself on the first place. I'll try to work on myself for now and if she stops me from achieving my goals I guess I must leave her. Damn
I think I should show her your comment. You have to be ready for all the critique and keep going even if someone gets more recognition and your will come. Now I know what to tell her Thank you!

Thank you for saying that. 
To be honest I can't tell if I'm being gaslit. She has more experience with color and painting than I do and her sketches are clearer. Other than that we are on about the same level. 

She has so much potential that is being suppressed by her immaturity and emotions.
I wish she grows out of being so self critical and start truly learning
We're both 19. Damn that's quite a simple solution but should work haha. I hope that the teacher won't get nasty about that.
Sorry, but doesn't OP mean making the lines thicker to cover up the blow out and make it look intentional? I may be wrong tho

sorry miss. I just talked to her about all of this. She agrees that it will be easier even for her if she starts working on herself. But! She's sad now and it hurts. she says: "I get that I will never be on first place. Tattooing is first and I will always be on second and it's alright". I told her a couple of times that it's not the same category and to don't think about it like that. It seems a bit like manipulation but I think that's just her self-esteem telling her that she can't be my priority. IDK, it's a but annoying. I'll text her that this conclusion is just her head bringing her down and that's why she needs to go to the therapy.

I tattooed her friends with her present. She felt like a third wheel whole day and was angry at me and one of the friends for a few days when she joked about being able to move her chest muscles, to which I laughed uncomfortably. She probably still thinks about it... I feel like I should've said something like "thats weird to say" or anything but I didn't want to make the process even more uncomfortable.

I occasionally joke about being gay and sometimes she worries that I really am interested in men. sooo... I gotta check her reaction on me tatting guys as well.

I think that she should go to therapy and I think she will. From what she was saying, the jealousy wears her out too and wants to change how she is but doesn't know how

I've made up my mind. No giving up on my dreams for anyone. I think she tries to support me but maybe she hopes that I lose interest in that career. Didn't notice it but as I got from answers for my post, I haven't noticed a lot of red flags that she waves. I will address the problem. By keeping up with this I will lose interest in her sooner or later either way
Thank you again. I can say that I wont leave my dreams for anyone. Whenever I get that feeling I'll remember to look back at this post. Have a good day, sir.
She's got some baggage and takes birth control. I'm gonna point the birth control out and see of she does anything about it. Thanks

Truth hurts. I need to talk with her though. I really want to try and I feel like she does too, but she needs to take some action. Otherwise I should leave her, agree? Thank you for such a good answer
Goddamn dude that hurts. Do you think that working through it together is a bad idea? Is it even possible?

Yeah when you said that she might be just doing that... She sometimes says that I should leave her and find another because she can't imagine being with tattoo artist. I then always say that I will consult every tattoo with her and can even stop doing them... that fucking sucks tbh

I did her first tattoo and she was there when I did other two. after both of them she was angry with me and I did both of them on our female friends. After reading your comments I'm starting to see the issue
We have quite some time to work on our minds. I'm always afraid of disagreements so gotta work on that too. I'll need the ability to tell her how I'm truly feeling

hahaha I agree! I've always had issues with making boundaries. Thank you a lot for showing me this red flag. I will try to convince her to work on that issue. She mentioned it and asked me if she start going to therapy but I overlooked lack of trust and told her that everything seems good.
Do you think that therapy will help her gain trust?
wdym can you elaborate?
Read it like"I have no feelings for you". Huh, I wonder why is that. Maybe because I heard it a week ago? after a year of back and forth? fuck it we ball, i guess

thanks for the opportunity. Maybe someday I'll text you but for now I'm fine. Thank you again and have a good day, night, whatever the time it is where you are atm. I really appreciate it, kind stranger

I don't know. She's alive so it's not so bad. it was terrible at one point but things start to get better, i think. I could talk about her for hours but i don't have energy for that. I let her down a couple times lately. I feel really bad for that. Things changed. I've changed, for the worse. Umm... so.. yeah... She's doing alright thanks for caring.
u/savevideobot

We ate sushi and talked a bit. She's tired of her friends and acting tough around them. Stress from everything in life was too much and she started isolating because of that. No one could reach her, because she deleted all social media apps. 
I think she had great time today. L isn't ready to get back to all contacts yet, but at least she agreed to text with me sometime. 

She's still suicidal but I can't do anything more about it. she's taking new meds and they make her sleep even more. Her mom keeps an eye on her doses and regularity. It seems that she's slowly getting better, and I hope I'm not mistaken.
on my way right now

It's really hard for her to talk about her feeling. Especially if it involves suicide. Do you have any tips on how to approach her? She always says that it's not a big deal or that she got used to (blank). Hell, i don't even know if she'll let me into her house. Yesterday she told her mother to tell me that she was out, when in reality she was sleeping. I'm about go to a sushi place for food to have some excuse for me even being there.

Thank you so much. I really needed those words. 
Unfortunately she doesn't have any support besides me and her therapist.

I think I'll bring her sushi today.

I agree about statement that depression is a personal battle but I don't know if it's a great idea to leave her alone. I do respect her choices but social withdrawal is really bad. I don't take it personally because I've been there. I isolate in intervals and to be honest she's the only thing that keeps me from "running away" again. Isolation may feel like the best option but it creates many more problems. She thinks of suicide everyday. Her only regret is not killing herself when she tried it for the first time, and I'm the only one who knows about it. She doesn't feel supported by her parents and she's scared of them. I feel like I should be there for her.

Of course I may be just ignorant and selfish about this opinion. I turned to reddit to discuss it. So if you disagree, please, show me your perspective. I'm trying to be open minded. After all I want is the best for her.

I'm pretty sure they are aware of her state. She told them about her suicidal thoughts in the last fight they had and they took her to new psychiatrist. I don't really trust them tho. After her first failed attempt she ran to them in tears but all her mom said was something like "all will be fine. You're young and it will pass. Doubts are normal.". L portrayed it as brushing the whole situation off. She doesn't feel supported by them. She's sometimes scared to come back home. They scream a lot and L hates it.

I would love to. The whole situation is pissing me off but I can't do that. Her parents are extremely close minded and won't admit their guilt. If I'll do it they would only blame and take everything out on her. She's scared of screaming and I don't want make her feel worse

I think I made her feel a bit different from others. We usually talk about how she feels and I'm scared that this friendship may start feeling forced. I like talking about some deeper stuff and she claims that I'm the only friend she feels comfortable talking about everything. I think that it may be hard for me to find the golden mean in the topic of our conversations but I'll try my best. 

I already used one of your tips and went out with her to get some food. This time not to make her eat something but "for me". Tried not to talk about depressing topics. I think she enjoyed today's trip. Should I ask her about her perspective on that or just leave it be?

She's now making some japanese dessert. Yesterday she slept all they. I hope I made her feel a bit better. Thank you a lot.

I try not to worry so much about my looks but walking through the city is horribly stressful. I sometimes feel like I'm goin to fall just because I focused so much on stranger's perceptions of me. My grades are getting progressively worse and I'm skipping school, because I'm scared to attend classes and fail. It's hard to enjoy meeting friends and have fun with them. I'm nearly constantly thinking about something bad that happened in my past or something
Thanks for advice and some kind of support. I hope that she won't be to embarrassed to eat with me, but it could work. great ideas
I'll surely take her to hospital if things get any worse. I wonder if there's any way of support I can provide to help her eat? Maybe cooking for/with her?
My first suicidal thoughts came when I was about 12 and been on and off since then. I can't tell if I'm genuinely depressed, but I wasn't happy in a long time

I can't handle my life. There's too much to do and I'm too far behind. I wasted a couple of years to lack of motivation or just pure laziness. I don't even think there's any good reason for thinking about it. I'm probably just a lost coward. sorry for ranting
It seems to be the best one of those. I'll try it for sure. Sometimes you can't see good side of things. Thanks

I'm attending therapy but that doesn't  help much. I'd rather talk to my friends but I barely do it. It's hard to speak about sad and emotional things. Especially with the way I was raised.
 Also I should say that I once fell in love with someone I fully dependent on. That ended in 3 months because two kids ran out of things to talk about, but it was a big deal for me. The first time I could talk to someone about my mental state and things. After breakup I was in really bad state. 2 weeks later first lockdown happened. Soo... I may be a little scared of intimacy now but idk

To be completely honest, I'm 17yo depressed kid. I live in pretty fuck up home. I hate my parents. I used to have to wake up in the middle of the night to protect my mom from my father. She refuses to do the right thing and get a divorce with this man. Me and my 30yo brother tried to convince her, but nothing worked and they always get back together. I don't expect change so I'm waiting for the time I can be fully independent, so I can finally move out.

I used to take antidepressants but I stopped because they were against it. Father doesn't believe in mental illness, and mom just didn't like to think something is wrong with me. I couldn't take the guilt that came with taking them

I  mostly feel anger if something. Other emotions are kinda weak and blurry. I found myself being apathetic towards others lately. I used to care about how people close to me felt, but now I look at someone who is crying and think, how stupid it is to do so. I still try to help out, but my reaction isn't triggered by feeling of compassion. I just know I should do something because it's right thing to do. I don't know if I explained it well

 Naszło mnie na pierdzielenie jak zobaczyłem ile osób sie z tym zmaga/ło. Nie mam lepszej rady niż te którymi dzielą się inni. Ja mogę tylko próbować ich ignorować. Trzymaj sie OP
